changelog:
- Initial release of the regime-confluence skill.
- Provides a real-time multi-timeframe regime agreement score for higher-confidence trading entries.
- Integrates with Kraken, Coinbase Advanced Trade, and Hyperliquid; no backtesting or third-party data.
- Requires only an EVM wallet with USDC on Base; no API key or subscription needed.
- Offers tiered, pay-per-call pricing with automatic early adopter discounts.
summary: Multi-timeframe regime agreement score for higher-confidence entries
